ns2:section.sectionText: Future Politics: What can political science learn from science fiction? How can we use what we currently know about politics, society, and economics to more create plausible and compelling visions of the future? In this course we will read social science together with science fiction in an attempt to enhance the currently impoverished political, social and economic imagination of the social sciences.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
